verdict.rationale: The Division documents its own ways to get records out: online retrieval of copies of filed business documents, UCC filing copies and depository account statements. It also documents a dissolve, cancel or withdraw path for leaving the registry. Nothing shows a bulk or complete export of a user's data, or that any output is in an open, machine-readable format. missing for 10: comprehensive all-data export, documented open/machine-readable export formats, bulk or programmatic retrieval, independent corroboration.
